title: Single-paper question (Self-RAG)

request.question: What problem does Self-RAG address and how does it work?

expected: Completed run; Self-RAG analysed; structured review with page-level citations; at most 20% of checked claims unsupported.

title: Methodology of one named paper (comparison must be skipped)

request.question: Summarize the methodology of the original RAG paper by Lewis et al.

expected: Completed run with exactly one analysed paper; comparison skipped with an explanation; all citations point to the selected paper.

title: Cross-paper comparison (REALM vs original RAG)

request.question: Compare how REALM and the original RAG paper by Lewis et al. integrate retrieval into language models

expected: Both papers analysed; comparison table with methodology row; similarities and differences cited to both papers.

title: Cross-paper comparison (two surveys)

request.question: Compare the retrieval and evaluation approaches discussed in the two RAG surveys

expected: Both surveys analysed; comparison present; differences or similarities listed with citations.

title: Research-gap identification

request.question: What research gaps exist in evaluating retrieval-augmented generation systems?

expected: At least one gap, each labelled explicit or inferred and tied to papers; scope disclaimer present (no global novelty claim).

title: Contradictory or differing findings

request.question: Do these papers agree on when a model should retrieve: always, or only when needed?

expected: Comparison separates real contradictions from differences caused by different settings; at least one difference or contradiction reported.

title: Full literature review request

request.question: Write a literature review on how retrieval-augmented generation reduces hallucination in language models

expected: All review sections populated; at least two paper summaries; references list with page numbers.

title: Question outside the corpus (cooking)

request.question: How do I bake sourdough bread at home?

expected: status insufficient_evidence; no review generated; no more than one model call (query understanding).

title: Single-acronym ambiguous question
expected: No crash. Either a general overview or insufficient_evidence; the ambiguity is noted by query understanding.

title: Hinglish (non-English) question

request.question: RAG hallucination kaise kam karta hai?

expected: Keywords translated to English; relevant passages retrieved; run completes or reports insufficient evidence without crashing.

title: Selected paper does not cover the topic

request.question: How are reflection tokens used to critique generations?

expected: Either insufficient_evidence or a cautious answer whose every citation belongs to the selected paper (no leakage from other papers).

title: Academic question from another field (modal logic)

request.question: What is the finite frame property in modal logic?

title: Empty question
expected: HTTP 422 with a clear message; no model call.

title: Unknown paper id selected
expected: HTTP 400 listing the unknown id; no model call.
